ios.desc:
Skip the group chat chaos. Hang out faster.
Hangs makes it easy to plan real-life hangouts with your closest friends. Whether you're organizing a dinner, a spontaneous coffee, or just want to see who’s around, Hangs cuts through the noise.

## Plan Together, Effortlessly

Suggest multiple times or places — your friends vote

Choose a neighborhood if you’re undecided

Confirm the best plan with a tap

## Spontaneous? Let people know.

Broadcast that you're free now with a spontaneous hang

Pick a place or area and see who joins

Limit visibility to just your city or your close friends

## Only your people

Invite individuals or entire groups

Keep hangs private or let friends discover and join

Create friend groups for easier planning

No strangers. Just your trusted crew.

## Extra Handy

Sync with your iOS Calendar

Open maps directly in Apple Maps

Share with non-users via secure link

Push notifications so no one misses a beat

Sign in with Apple for privacy and speed

Connect IRL. Keep it real.
Because nothing beats hanging out face-to-face.

quotes.text: I learned swift to make an app… to hang out with your pals because group chats are a mess. Skip the endless texts. Pick a time, pick a place, get together — fast.
